root_cause: Real product defect, not a flaky test. The generated-code tier case (test-management case C34691 'post a comment') fails at its final verify: after clicking Post the task's Comments panel count stays at 5 instead of incrementing to 6, and the failure screenshot from context.failure.screenshots shows the new comment row absent from the panel while a green 'Comment posted' toast is visible — the classic false-success signal. The Source-code analyzer traced it to web/src/comments/commentsStore.js: createComment() awaits the POST but pushes the returned record onto `items` only inside an `if (res.status === 201)` branch, while the API returns 200 (not 201) on create, so the store never appends and the panel never re-renders. The case code is correct; the app is wrong (failure_layer app_bug). Cause vs symptom: the symptom is 'count did not increment'; the cause is the brittle 201-only status check.
summary: app_bug: commentsStore.createComment() only appends on HTTP 201 but the API returns 200 — the new comment never enters local state, so the panel count never increments. Proposed a 2xx-tolerant check.
notes: Line number (42) is pinned to the current build — re-anchor against HEAD before applying. Two-agent swarm agreed: the Screenshot+Error analyzer classified it as cause #4-adjacent (state not updated despite success) and the Source analyzer confirmed the 201-only branch.
